en.title_issue: Label data checks and narrow investigation
en.hook_line: More than 20 blister seal complaints, but the investigation covered one lot only
en.summary: FDA issued a Form 483 with 3 observations to The Harvard Drug Group LLC dba Major Pharmaceuticals and Rugby Laboratories, an own-label distributor, repackager and relabeler, citing verification of label variable data, investigation scope and DSCSA verification systems.
key_facts: Observation 1: procedure does not require the quality unit to verify lot number and expiration date on labels against the Certificate of Compliance before release
Observation 2: investigation SCAR-000303 not extended to other lots after the root cause was a defective sealing process and material
Observation 3: no systems to comply with the verification requirements of section 582(b) of the DSCSA
en.implication: SOP-05162 became effective on December 8, 2025 (Observation 1). More than 20 complaints of inadequate blister seal strength were received between December 12, 2025, and March 3, 2026 (Observation 2). The investigation focused on one product lot and led to a recall (Observation 2). The quality unit released multiple lots and products made with the same process and materials (Observation 2). The SOPs do not address identifying suspect product before it reaches the distribution center or responding to notifications of illegitimate product (Observation 3).
checks: Are lot number and expiry on labels checked against the CoC before release, with a record? (Observation 1)
Do packaging defect investigations review other lots made with the same process and materials? (Observation 2)
Is there a procedure for responding to notifications of illegitimate product? (Observation 3)

key_facts: 관찰 1: 일반의약품 액제·연고를 만드는 위탁 시설과의 계약이 핵심 품질 책임을 정하지 않음
fda483-196426.implication: 계약에 안정성 시험의 책임 주체, 요건, 보관 조건, 판정 기준이 없었다(관찰 1). 계약은 공정·설비·시설 변경 때 통보를 요구하지 않았다(관찰 1). 계약에 정기 감사 권한 조항이 없었다(관찰 1).
checks: 위탁 계약에 안정성 시험 책임 주체가 정해져 있는가? (관찰 1)

en.hook_line: Contract agreements lack stability responsibilities and the right to audit

D-0173-2027.summary: 시아노코발라민 주사 1,000 mcg/mL이 입자성 물질 혼입으로 회수됐다(Class II).
key_facts: 사유: 입자성 물질 혼입 — 해당 배치의 유리 입자 오염(유리 조각) 의심
제품·범위: 시아노코발라민 주사 1,000 mcg/mL 다회용 바이알, 로트 24394A, 4,097상자
등급: Class II
D-0173-2027.implication: 제조사 American Regent, Inc.가 BluePoint Pharmaceuticals Laboratories에 해당 배치의 유리 입자 오염 의심을 통보했다.
checks: 주사제 공급업체에서 유리 입자 통보를 받으면 같은 배치 재고를 바로 격리하는가?
입고 주사제 바이알의 유리 조각을 육안검사로 확인하는가?

en.hook_line: Cyanocobalamin injection recalled for potential glass fragment contamination
en.summary: Cyanocobalamin injection 1,000 mcg/mL was recalled for presence of particulate matter (Class II).
key_facts: Reason: presence of particulate matter — potential glass particle contamination (foreign glass fragment) in the batch
Product and scope: cyanocobalamin injection 1,000 mcg/mL multiple-dose vials, lot 24394A, 4,097 cartons
Class: Class II
en.implication: American Regent, Inc. notified BluePoint Pharmaceuticals Laboratories of potential glass particle contamination identified in the product batch.
checks: Is same-batch stock quarantined at once when a supplier reports glass particles?
Are incoming injection vials visually inspected for glass fragments?

quotes_translation: 입자성 물질 혼입: American Regent, Inc.
가 BluePoint Pharmaceuticals Laboratories에 해당 제품 배치에서 확인된 유리 입자 오염(유리 조각) 의심을 통보했다.

key_facts: 사유: 다른 정제·캡슐 혼입(Presence of Foreign Tablets/Capsules)
제품·범위: 메토프롤롤 타르타르산염 정제 50 mg 1,000정 병, 배치 2611C065A1, 3684병
등급: Class II

en.title_issue: Recall for foreign tablets or capsules
en.hook_line: Metoprolol tablet bottles recalled for presence of foreign tablets or capsules
en.summary: Metoprolol tartrate tablets 50 mg were recalled for presence of foreign tablets/capsules (Class II).
key_facts: Reason: presence of foreign tablets/capsules
Product and scope: metoprolol tartrate tablets 50 mg, 1,000-count bottle, batch 2611C065A1, 3684 bottles

recall-fb-24e87667c9a6a108.summary: 조제 의약품인 글루타치온 200 mg/mL 주사액이 무균 제품 미생물 오염으로 회수됐다(등급 미확정).
key_facts: 사유: 무균 제품 미생물 오염 — 엔도톡신 시험에서 기준일탈(OOS) 결과

등급: Not Yet Classified(미확정)

en.hook_line: Compounded glutathione injection recalled after out-of-specification endotoxin results
en.summary: Glutathione 200 mg/mL injection solution, a compounded product, was recalled for microbial contamination of sterile products (not yet classified).
key_facts: Reason: microbial contamination of sterile products — out-of-specification results for bacterial endotoxin
Product and scope: glutathione 200 mg/mL injection solution (compounded), 209 units
Class: not yet classified

quotes_translation: 무균 제품 미생물 오염: 엔도톡신 시험에서 기준일탈 결과가 나왔다.

who-whopir-492199ae88d3.summary: WHO가 Cipla Limited 쿠르쿰브 완제의약품 제조소(인도)를 실사하고 WHO GMP 지침을 수용 가능한 수준으로 준수한다고 판정했다.
key_facts: 결론: WHO GMP 지침 준수 수준 수용 가능, 실사 미준수 사항은 공개 전 모두 해결, 유효기간 3년

en.summary: WHO inspected a Cipla Limited finished pharmaceutical product site in Kurkumbh, India, and found it operating at an acceptable level of compliance with WHO GMP Guidelines.
key_facts: Conclusion: acceptable compliance with WHO GMP; non-compliances addressed before publication; valid for 3 years

who-whopir-98cfb8b39789.summary: WHO가 Lupin Limited 앙클레슈와르 에탐부톨 원료의약품 공장(인도)을 서류 평가해 원료의약품 WHO GMP 지침을 수용 가능한 수준으로 준수한다고 판정했다.
key_facts: 결론: 현장 실사 대신 서류 평가로 원료의약품 WHO GMP 준수 수준 수용 가능, 유효기간 3년
who-whopir-98cfb8b39789.implication: WHO는 USA FDA 실사(2026-03-02~07·2022-08-16~19)와 TGA 실사(2024-10-03~04) 등 이전 실사와 GMP 증거를 근거로 서류 평가를 받아들였다.

en.title_issue: API GMP accepted by desk assessment
en.summary: WHO assessed a Lupin Limited ethambutol API plant in Ankleshwar, India, by desk review and found it operating at an acceptable level of compliance with WHO GMP guidelines for APIs.
key_facts: Conclusion: desk assessment accepted in lieu of onsite inspection; acceptable compliance with WHO GMP for APIs; valid for 3 years
en.implication: WHO accepted the desk assessment based on previous inspections, including USA FDA inspections (2026-03-02 to 07 and 2022-08-16 to 19) and a TGA inspection (2024-10-03 to 04), and GMP evidence reviewed.

who-whopir-af14a079113a.summary: WHO가 Neuland Laboratories Limited Unit-I 원료의약품 제조소(인도)를 서류 평가해 원료의약품 WHO GMP 지침을 수용 가능한 수준으로 준수한다고 판정했다.
key_facts: 결론: 현장 실사 대신 서류 평가로 원료의약품 WHO GMP 준수 수준 수용 가능, 유효기간 3년
who-whopir-af14a079113a.implication: 서류 평가는 USFDA 실사(2024-03-18~22)와 EDQM/ANSM 실사(2023-06-07~09) 자료를 근거로 했다.

en.title_issue: API GMP accepted by desk assessment
en.summary: WHO assessed the Neuland Laboratories Limited Unit-I API site in India by desk review and found it operating at an acceptable level of compliance with WHO GMP guidelines for APIs.
key_facts: Conclusion: desk assessment accepted in lieu of onsite inspection; acceptable compliance with WHO GMP for APIs; valid for 3 years
en.implication: The desk assessment relied on a USFDA inspection (2024-03-18 to 22) and an EDQM/ANSM inspection (2023-06-07 to 09).

who-whopir-d6ea75f7687f.summary: WHO가 Oxalis Labs 제조소(인도)를 실사하고 WHO GMP 지침을 수용 가능한 수준으로 준수한다고 판정했다.
key_facts: 결론: WHO GMP 지침 준수 수준 수용 가능, 실사 미준수 사항은 공개 전 모두 해결, 유효기간 3년

en.summary: WHO inspected the Oxalis Labs site in India and found it operating at an acceptable level of compliance with WHO GMP Guidelines.
